records.title: Two-Year Data on the Efficacy and Safety of the MINIject Supraciliary Implant in Patients with Medically Uncontrolled Primary Open-Angle Glaucoma
records.summary: Retrospective study of 37 eyes followed for 24 months, including combined cataract procedures and standalone implantation.
records.editorialNotes: Study assessed pressure and medication use. Longer follow-up is needed; observational results are not an individual treatment promise.

records.title: Real-World Data of the First UK Series of MINIject Supraciliary Glaucoma Implant with 6 Months Follow-Up
